intentionalDifference: Unknown generic ecosystem extensions are preserved and separately reported per approved R3v0.3; reference validator treats extra fields as errors.

cases.label: invalid-name
cases.referenceReport:
Validation failed for /private/tmp/axon-r3-reference/invalid-name/Sample:
  - Skill name 'Sample' must be lowercase

axonIssues.message: name须为1至64个小写字母、数字或单连字符，可使用Unicode字符。

cases.label: missing-description
cases.referenceReport:
Validation failed for /private/tmp/axon-r3-reference/missing-description/sample:
  - Missing required field in frontmatter: description

axonIssues.message: description须为非空且不超过1024字符。

cases.label: custom-extension
cases.referenceReport:
Validation failed for /private/tmp/axon-r3-reference/custom-extension/sample:
  - Unexpected fields in frontmatter: x-product. Only ['allowed-tools', 'compatibility', 'description', 'license', 'metadata', 'name'] are allowed.

axonIssues.message: 扩展字段x-product原文保留，Axon不自动应用其调用或权限配置。
